Hi Sofia — thanks for sending these over and welcome. I pulled the attachments and ran the quick checks we do for US payees. A couple of notes / next steps so we can progress to PO creation: 

1) W-9 / EIN verification
- The W-9 you attached is almost complete but the EIN digits printed on page 1 don’t match the name string in our verification tool (small OCR mismatch). Could you confirm the EIN and resend a clear scan (PDF) of the W-9 with the EIN block legible? A photo of the signed form is fine if the PDF text is blurry.

2) Bank letter
- Bank letter looks good — please ensure it includes the full legal name exactly as on the W-9. If the company invoices under a DBA, please note that in your reply so we can map invoice-to-supplier properly.

3) Supplier profile and tax residency
- We require a short supplier intake form for our AP system. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/vendor-onboarding-ledgerly (upload the W-9 there).
- If Ledgerly is claiming any tax treaty or exemption, attach the signed W-8BEN-E (for foreign entities) — otherwise W-9 is sufficient for US entities.

4) PO timing and payment terms
- Standard timeline: once docs are validated, Procurement creates a PO within 7 business days. If you need an expedited PO (for first invoice milestone), let us know and we can request a priority queue (expedite requests require a reason).
- Default payment terms are NET30 unless alternative terms were negotiated.

Please resend a clean W-9 (or confirm EIN in reply) and confirm the invoicing name you expect on the PO. I’ll route to Ben for PO creation as soon as we have the validated files.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
